vulnerability.name: GHSA-5jq2-8x83-x246
vulnerability.description: pypdf: Possible long runtimes/large memory usage when parsing indirect objects

statements.status_notes: Fixed in commit 64e3034: pyproject.toml raises the [books] floor to pypdf>=6.19.0; the lock resolves 6.21.1. Re-scan security/osv/2026-10-17-osv-after-pypdf.json has no pypdf hits. Before the fix: Reachable. booksearch parses PDFs with PdfReader, which reads indirect objects. A crafted PDF can cause long runtimes (DoS only). Only PDFs the user chooses to index are parsed. Fixed in pypdf 6.18.0. Evidence: scripts/booksearch.py:193,197,205 (only pypdf use in the repo: PdfReader(...) then page.extract_text()); pyproject.toml:42 (optional [books] extra)

vulnerability.name: GHSA-vxq7-64xx-v4gw
vulnerability.description: urllib3: HTTPResponse.stream()/read_chunked() buffers an unbounded chunk-size line into memory

statements.impact_statement: Reachable only through tiktoken downloading its BPE file with requests.get from one fixed URL chosen by tiktoken. An attacker would need to control that TLS-protected host. The path is optional and offline-tuner only; apex-router does not use urllib3 directly. Evidence: src/apex_router/proxy_engine/tuner/tokens.py:57-59 (tiktoken.get_encoding); pyproject.toml:38 (optional [tuner] extra); uv.lock: urllib3 is reached only through requests, which only tiktoken pulls in; tiktoken/load.py:15-17 calls requests.get() on a fixed URL

vulnerability.name: GHSA-gh4c-6fx4-qh6g
vulnerability.description: urllib3: Chunked Deflate streaming can enter an infinite loop

statements.impact_statement: Same path as GHSA-vxq7-64xx-v4gw. A malicious server must send a crafted chunked deflate response. The only server contacted is the fixed tiktoken download host. Evidence: src/apex_router/proxy_engine/tuner/tokens.py:57-59 (tiktoken.get_encoding); pyproject.toml:38 (optional [tuner] extra); uv.lock: urllib3 is reached only through requests, which only tiktoken pulls in; tiktoken/load.py:15-17 calls requests.get() on a fixed URL

vulnerability.name: GHSA-8988-9cw3-xx77
vulnerability.description: urllib3: HTTPS proxy TLS configuration may be ignored or overridden

statements.impact_statement: Needs an HTTPS proxy with a custom proxy TLS configuration. The repo sets no proxy and passes no proxy_ssl_context. git grep finds no HTTPS_PROXY use in src, scripts or tests. Evidence: pyproject.toml:38; tiktoken/load.py:15-17 (plain requests.get); git grep HTTPS_PROXY|proxy_ssl_context returns no match in the repo
